It's the last week in October, which means one thing - COP17 is almost coming to a close. COP17 Armenia has had a sharp focus on Biodiversity and Business but with only days to go, there is still a huge gap between intention, policy and implementation. A big two weeks in sustainability - major reports dropping on carbon emissions and on biodiversity - neither making good reading. What does make good reading is our Best of LinkedIn posts - in this edition we highlight some really punchy and informative posts from Nathaniel Burola , Sasja Beslik , Survival International , Ramon Pueyo Viñuales and GlobeScan . All well worth a read and a follow.
As always, a big thank you to our co-editor Emily Stone-Wigg for pulling this edition together. 👏
Great to see Hula Earth featured in the innovation spotlight especially as COP17 Armenia is in it's last week and there is such an awful lot of attention and heated discussion around measurement, data and accountability of biodiversity and nature.
